# Introduction

Load libraries and pull in data from data_cleaning.R (personal_weights and species_responses). Also print out a column of variables and variable types so I can check on data before running it.

```{r load data, echo=F, warning=T, message=T}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(psych)
library(lavaan)
library(knitr)

pers <- readRDS(here("data", "personal_weights.rds"))
sp <- readRDS(here("data", "species_responses.rds")) %>%
  filter(vsid %in% pers$vsid)

summ <- function(df) tibble(
  variable = names(df),
  type = map_chr(df, ~ class(.x)[1]),
  pct_na = round(map_dbl(df, ~ mean(is.na(.x))) * 100, 1),
  n_unique = map_int(df, ~ n_distinct(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
)

print(summ(sp), n = Inf)
print(summ(pers), n = Inf)

```
Running some exploratory factor analysis on these characteristics. Trying 3 or 4 to see which works

```{r}
chars <- c("conservation_status", "edibility", "familiarity", "desire_to_see", "wtp_hunt", "wtp_view", "danger_humans", "destructive_property")

X <- sp %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(chars), ~ !is.na(.x))) %>%
  select(all_of(chars))

fa.parallel(X, fa = "fa", cor = "poly")   #suggests how many factors
efa <- fa(X, nfactors = 3, cor = "poly", rotate = "oblimin") #trying 3
print (efa$loadings, cutoff = 0.3)

efa$Phi
```
Tried on both 3 and 4, 3 loads better. Edibility kind of sticks out on its own. Thinking of these final species-level boxes.

1) Value (desire to see, WTP (see), WTP (hunt))
2) Threat (danger, destructiveness)
3) Commonness (familiarity, conservation status)
4) Edibility



Running another factor analysis on the personal/demographics data.
```{r}
idvars <- grep("^identify_", names(pers), value = TRUE)
fa.parallel(pers[, idvars], fa = "fa", cor = "poly")
efa_id <- fa(pers[, idvars], nfactors = 2, cor = "poly", rotate = "oblimin")
print(efa_id$loadings, cutoff = 0.3)
```
Showing that there's a consumptive/land-based identity set and a non-consumptive set.

1) MR1: hunters, ranchers, farmers, anglers, small business, landowners
2) MR2: outdoor viewers, outdoor rec, environmentalists

Small business and landowners load below the rest,but I think it's fine.

Now trying to run a CFA on what we have so far.

```{r}
cfa_mod <- '
  mutualism      =~ wvo_animal_rights + wvo_one_family + wvo_side_by_side
  domination     =~ wvo_human_needs_priority + wvo_wildlife_for_use + wvo_kill_if_threat
  cns            =~ cns_item1 + cns_item2 + cns_item3 + cns_item4 + cns_item5 + cns_item6
  consumptive    =~ identify_hunters + identify_ranchers + identify_farmers +
                    identify_small_business + identify_landowners + identify_anglers
  nonconsumptive =~ identify_environmentalists + identify_outdoor_rec + identify_outdoor_viewers
'
ords <- grep("^(wvo_(animal|one|side|human|wildlife|kill)|cns_item|identify_)", names(pers), value = TRUE)
fit  <- cfa(cfa_mod, data = pers, ordered = ords, estimator = "WLSMV")

fitMeasures(fit, c("cfi.scaled", "tli.scaled", "rmsea.scaled", "srmr"))
standardizedSolution(fit) %>% filter(op == "=~")     # loadings
standardizedSolution(fit) %>% filter(op == "~~", lhs != rhs)  # factor correlations

efa_id$Phi
table(pers$eats_meat, pers$game_meat_freq)
```
